positions.title: AI Scientist
positions.locationName: Live Oak, Florida, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Research Scientist
positions.description:
- Clinical AI agent development for hospital revenue cycle and diagnosis capture from EHR data (clinical notes, labs, imaging, structured data)
- Automated prompt engineering with genetic algorithms for clinical NLP pipelines
- FSDP training of LLMs on hyperscale clusters
- Prompt management, telemetry, and LLM evaluation infrastructure for healthcare AI systems
- Data flywheel engineering across clinical datasets
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Applied Mathematics · Software Development

positions.title: Head of AI Research And Development
positions.description:
• Led AI R&D for a clinical AI platform integrated into Epic EHR, developing agents for clinical documentation, patient outcome prediction, and care team decision support
• Designed and executed research initiatives with cross-functional teams (physicians, DevOps, engineers, AI scientists), translating clinical workflows into production AI systems processing EHR/EMR data
• Built fast-feedback development tracks for clinical AI agents and APIs, reducing cycle time and driving iterative learning in high-uncertainty healthcare environments
• Architected foundational ML systems and set technical direction for the transition from experimentation to production, supporting HIPAA-compliant deployment at scale
• Introduced improved clinical annotation workflows and modern evaluation tooling (Arize Phoenix, LLM-based CI/CD) to streamline development and monitoring of clinical AI agents

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · Remote
positions.description:

- Architect lowest cost ML infrastructure
- Implement a GPT4 + RAG powered chat bot to allow customers to talk to their structured data

positions.title: AI Scientist
positions.description:
- Architect and implement data pipelines for machine learning development

- Assist co-workers in obtaining machine learning skills with Python
- Evangelize MLOps and DevOps best practices

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:

- Evangelize modern best software engineering practices around MLOps in the cloud
- Research and development of new data science products
- Machine learning product management
